{{Quote|In my culture, vocal music is a sacred tradition, and it is the one thing that has kept me alive all this time.|Sy Snootles|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>}}
'''Sy Snootles''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] singer, and was also the lead vocalist for the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Snootles and her associated acts were favorites of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime families; during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in her solo career days, Snootles also acted as a part-time [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], being responsible for the assassination of [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro the Hutt]], her former lover, on [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] after being hired by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]].

She was a very close friend with dancer [[Greeata Jendowanian/Legends|Greeata Jendowanian]], and did not sign to sing for Max until Greeata's position was secured as well. Snootles also had a great relationship with fellow band member [[Droopy McCool/Legends|Droopy McCool]]. One of Snootles' most famous songs was "[[Lapti Nek/Legends|Lapti Nek]]," also a favorite of Jabba.

==Biography==
===Femme fatale===
{{Quote|Next time you'll think twice about breaking someone's heart. Oh, wait, there won't be a next time.|Sy Snootles before killing Ziro|<ref name="Hunt for Ziro">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>}}
[[File:SnootlesShootsZiro-HFZ.png|thumb|left|220px|Sy shooting Ziro]]
Sy Snootles was a successful singer and performing artist. At one point during the timeframe surrounding the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Sy Snootles had dated and fallen in love with [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], a prominent [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime lord.<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref> Ziro was [[Raid on Ziro the Hutt's Coruscant club|imprisoned]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after a kidnapping plot involving his nephew [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] son [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]];<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> when Ziro was freed from [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|prison]],<ref name="Hostage Crisis">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref> Jabba hired Snootles to steal the Hutt's [[Holopad/Legends|holopad]], as it contained potentially damaging information pertaining to the Hutt crime families.<ref name=":0" />

Her former lover was being kept in a cell on the Hutt homeworld [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. To make her cover convincing, Sy danced for the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] on Nal Hutta, where she freed Ziro from the captive Hutts by tricking two [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards into fighting each other, distracting the others. [[File:Sy_Snootles_poster.png|thumb|150px|A poster promoting Snootles' concerts during the Clone Wars.]]Snootles wanted to have Ziro lead her to the holopad, which was hidden on [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. Borrowing [[Mama/Legends|Ziro's mother's]] starship, they traveled to Teth, where she found the hidden diary at Ziro's [[Papa/Legends|father's]] gravesite. Snootles felt her job was done and pointed a blaster at Ziro; Ziro pled for his life, but to no avail: Snootles shot and killed the Hutt. She then delivered the diary to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where she was paid by Jabba.<ref name=":0" />

===Musical success===
Sy Snootles had big dreams of being a successful musician and was determined to see those aspirations realized at all costs. Teaming up with a [[Letaki]] singer, multi-instrumentalist and musical impresario named [[Evar Orbus/Legends|Evar Orbus]], she became a singer in his [[Evar Orbus and His Galactic Jizz-Wailers]] band. After Orbus's death during an altercation with [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Snootles saw her chance. Renaming the group the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] and persuading the group' amiable keyboardist Max Rebo take over as bandleader (thus providing an obvious target for bounty hunters and rival musicians), Sy planned to control the band safely from behind the scenes. At this time, she also convinced the [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonak]] woodwind player [[Droopy McCool/Legends|Snit]] to adopt the more striking stage name "Droopy McCool" and hired a number of other musicians to fill out the band. Unfortunately for Sy, her ambitions were upset when a booking agent working for Jabba the Hutt approached the more pliable Rebo, who signed the band on to an exclusive contract at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] in exchange for a lifetime supply of free food.

[[File:Snootles_with_claws.png|thumb|left|upright|Sy Snootles.]]
Always pragmatic, Sy was outraged at the [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan's]] deal and often worked behind the Hutt's back, trying to revoke their arrangement with Jabba. She also worked as a spy amongst Jabba's varied enemies, giving information in exchange for extra credits besides her share of the Band's profits. In truth, Sy was acting as a double agent, as the information she shared with Jabba's enemies were, in truth, falsehoods provided to her by [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], the Hutt's [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]].

After [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|Jabba's death]], the Max Rebo Band broke up and went their separate ways. Sy continued to pursue a solo career but found little success, due to the fact that most beings found her singing to be "weird."<ref name="SWCE" /> She was seen as a rival of fellow Pa'lowick singing sensation, [[Larisselle Chatrunis]], a former [[Miss Coruscant]] winner.<ref name="Hnn-Chatrunis Crowned Miss Coruscant">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|life/13418_1.html|Chatrunis Crowned Miss Coruscant}}</ref> Despite the publicity, the rumored backstage drama did little for Sy's dwindling career, however, and the best she could muster were tours of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] under a variety of stage names. She would also become a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] addict, never able to reclaim her past fame.<ref>"[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]" — ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sy Snootles was originally portrayed as an elaborate puppet, but for the extended musical number in the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']], she was a CG character. In the Special Edition a frog-like mouth below the long, skinny one with tusks was removed, so that the CG character only had one mouth. The puppet can still be seen in the Special Edition, in the first shot of the band sequence.

During the production of ''Return of the Jedi'', Sy Snootles was referred to as Mrs. Snooty.<ref name="DB" />

The 1984 [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] action figure set listed [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]]'s name as Sy Snootles and the Rebo Band.<ref name="SWCA">{{WebCite|url=http://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=39670|text=Return of the Jedi Sy Snootles and the Rebo Band Action Figure Set|work=Star Wars Collectors Archive|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/VpASX}}</ref>

In "[[Hunt for Ziro]]," Sy Snootles was voiced by [[Nika Futterman]].<ref name=":0" />
